description:
Problem: review after zaq-1lw.17 found two newly introduced Mattermost-specific dependencies in the otherwise generic outgoing bridge. AdapterOptions.build/2 branches on [:mattermost, "mattermost"] to suppress max_upload_request_size; JidoChatBridge.file_requirements/2 debug logging reads Application.get_env(:jido_chat_mattermost, :max_file_size) and emits mattermost_defaults. Functional delivery tests passed but these violate the agreed ownership boundary.
Required change: remove both provider-specific branches/dependencies. Pass supported shared configuration keys consistently through AdapterOptions for every provider; the selected adapter owns resolving/ignoring its supported configuration and returns requirements. The corrected Mattermost adapter already ignores the retired upload-request option and declares no applicable request ceiling. ZAQ normalizes and validates requirements generically and owns planning/execution. Log safe selected-adapter requirements/results through existing DeliveryTrace; do not read provider application config or expose credentials, prepared requests or file contents. Do not replace these leaks with a provider-name table or move the same branching into another helper.
Scope: lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/adapter_options.ex, relevant requirements trace in jido_chat_bridge.ex, existing tests and directly affected docs. Review the new outgoing delivery path for equivalent coupling. Existing pre-base Mattermost DM/thread defaults and incoming provider normalization are outside this fix; record any separate findings without broad refactoring. No new callbacks/SDK changes unless independently demonstrated necessary. Preserve exact current dependency pins and other uncommitted work.
Acceptance: option construction is provider-independent for identical shared connection settings, covering atom/string Mattermost plus another provider. An obsolete Mattermost max_upload_request_size setting cannot affect its resolved requirements or stop delivery; a provider that declares a positive ceiling still has it enforced. Missing/invalid genuinely required values still fail by policy. Trace uses selected adapter results with no direct Mattermost app-env access. Reuse existing AdapterOptions/Jido delivery/requirements/planner tests and actual pinned Mattermost HTTP-boundary regression; retain upload/post assertions, stop/continue, exact encoding, threading and privacy. Preserve SMTP behavior and ordinary text path. Run focused tests and mix q; report mocked transport versus live evidence accurately.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, action-reuse.md, testing-approach.md, documentation.md and services/channels.md. Disclose any existing-test behavior migration under policy: current Mattermost option-suppression expectation must become uniform forwarding with actual adapter non-applicability assertions, retaining other adapter ceiling coverage. Do not weaken tests to obtain a pass.
Action reuse assessment: extend existing AdapterOptions, adapter requirements and DeliveryTrace boundaries; no new operation/Action/tool, no duplicated orchestration. This corrects zaq-1lw.17 and blocks final review zaq-1lw.12. Creation authorizes tracker changes only in this turn; no application code edits or commit/push. Implementing agent must follow session authorization and repository policies.

comments.text: Implementation authorized by latest user request. Test migration disclosed in zaq-1lw.18 and explicitly requested: replace Mattermost option suppression with uniform shared-option forwarding for identical connection settings (atom/string Mattermost and other providers); retain other-adapter ceiling assertions and strengthen actual pinned Mattermost HTTP regression with obsolete-option inputs as well as absence. Action reuse: extend existing AdapterOptions.build/2 and JidoChatBridge.file_requirements/2 trace; local configuration/diagnostic details, no new business operation, Action, callback or tool. Adapters remain authoritative for requirements; existing planner/executor own grouping, timing and failure policy. Plan: regress uniform forwarding in existing suite; remove provider branch/config read; verify actual adapter with absent/obsolete ceiling, declared ceilings, required-value failures, SMTP/text/privacy; inspect safe trace allowlist; mix q and pin/unrelated-diff checks. No E2E needed for this boundary correction; epic UX gate remains pending. No application commit/push.

Implementation progress: removed provider-name filtering from AdapterOptions.build/2; identical supported options are forwarded for all providers. Removed Mattermost app-env/defaults read from JidoChatBridge requirements tracing; existing selected-adapter result/mapped-requirements trace remains. Updated directly affected module/service docs. Existing suppression test migrated to uniform-forwarding property over atom/string providers, atom/string settings, direct-value precedence, transport and local policy exclusion. RED reproduced missing option before fix; focused suite now 93 passed (10 properties, 83 tests). Actual pinned Mattermost adapter/ReqClient HTTP-boundary scenario runs absent, top-level one-byte obsolete option and nested one-byte obsolete option, each under abort/continue, retaining auth, exact upload/post counts, original indices, root/thread and no-extra-request assertions. Existing positive-ceiling splitting/omission and invalid-required-value assertions preserved. This is a local HTTP stub at external transport, not a live Mattermost send. mix q passed. Audit of 588 current-run requirements trace lines: no provider defaults, credentials, prepared requests or file content; four obsolete-option lookups resolve through actual adapter to not_applicable. Outgoing coupling audit finds only pre-existing DM/incoming thread provider defaults outside requested scope, untouched. Pins byte-identical and dependency checkout clean; diff --check passed. Additional bridge/API/SMTP/text regression suite running.
